preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 300000 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Number of rooms in each test case is between 2 and 300000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n for s, n in zip(ss, ns))
preconditions.description: Length of the string s matches the number of rooms n.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '<>-' for c in s) for s in ss)
preconditions.description: String s consists only of '<', '>', and '-' characters.

postconditions.description: Number of return values matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= rv <= n for rv, n in zip(return_values, ns))
postconditions.description: Each return value is between 0 and the number of rooms.
